raw_segments.text: Why, you keep thinking of our present Earth. But our present Earth may have been repeated
a billion times. Why, it's become extinct, been frozen, cracked, broken to bits, disintegrated
into its elements, again, the water above the firmament. Then again a comet, again a
sun, again from the sun it becomes Earth. And the same sequence may have been repeated
endlessly and exactly the same to every detail, most unseemly and insufferably tedious.
